dct_description_sm: South Africa administrative level 0-4 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 4 levels: - Admin 1: 9 Province - Admin 2: 52 District - Admin 3: 213 Local municipality - Admin 4: 4392 Dates associated with this dataset: - 28 January 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 09 November 2020: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 27 December 2018: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 27 December 2018: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Regional Office for Southern and Eastern Africa (ROSEA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rosea). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
